sponsors: House Committee on Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications

status: Conference Committee Report adopted (House 114-10-1 on 2026-03-26; Senate 39-0-1 on 2026-03-27); enrolled and presented to Governor 2026-04-03; approved by Governor on 2026-04-09.
